notes:
Deal snapshot: fintech payments company evaluating Veridian Sentinels' customer support + fraud workflows. Heavy emphasis on embeddings for fast entity lookup and a reranking layer for transaction scoring. POC run Jan 20–Feb 10 (3 weeks).

POC outcome summary:
- Architecture: two-tier flow = lightweight hosted generation for chat + embeddings index for quick lookup. Reranker (on-prem style latency target) sits in front of scoring service.
- Performance: latencies met (avg generation 120ms p50, embedding lookups <15ms) on Redwood hosted test cluster.
- Cost modeling: internal finance built projected 5M tokens/mo baseline for chat + 20M embedding ops/mo for peak. Redwood cost estimate (hosted) came in ~3x higher than their threshold.
- Competitor angle: Anthropic Sales presented a committed credit plan with ~40% lower per-token effective cost at 1yr commit; they offered a GPU-backed dedicated SKU with a smaller upfront commit. CFO flagged Anthropic as the low-cost baseline.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "We can't commit to the kind of ARR you need for a useful discount — capital is tight this quarter." — VP Finance (2/05)
- "Security wants VPC/on-prem but timeline for that is 6+ months; procurement won't approve a six-month runway for a product we need in 8 weeks." — Head of Infra (1/29)

Internal AE/SE notes (shorthand):
- 1/22 kickoff call (FF-20250122-3490) — good fit tech; buyer = Dir. of ML + Head of Prod.
- 1/28 demo with SRE + security — asked for SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; we provided security FAQ (drive link).
- 2/05 pricing deep-dive w/finance — requested scenarios: no-commit POC pricing, 6m micro-commit, 12m enterprise commit.
- 2/18 follow-up: decision delayed — CFO running hiring freeze + capex hold through Q2.
- 2/20 last touchpoint: AE proposed trimmed model (2M tokens/mo tier, burst credits) — awaiting internal cost committee.

Why stalled / loss risk:
- Unit economics didn't pencil at their expected volume: token + embedding cost vs. business value margin for payments product.
- Required commit size for comparable unit cost (to Anthropic offer) exceeds their current capital appetite.
- No strong internal champion: Dir. of ML is overloaded; Head of Prod neutral; procurement risk-averse during hiring/cost freeze.
- Security team will only accept VPC + KMS with on-prem option on ~6–9 month timeline. They need faster turnaround.

Workarounds attempted:
- Offered a 6-week micro-POC priced flat for tokens to show production metrics (rejected by finance as still uncertain).
- Proposed hybrid routing: use Redwood hosted for embeddings and competitor low-cost for bulk generation — unacceptable due to data governance.
- Created a trimmed quantization + batching recommendation; projected 25% cost reduction if they accept slower latency for bulk scoring (not acceptable for realtime payments).

Staked next steps:
- AE: follow-up in early April after budget cycle; ask for internal champion re-engagement.
- SE: prepare a 1-page micro-POC priced option that fits <$25k upfront (need approval from Revenue Ops).
- Contingency: monitor Anthropic pricing cadence; if competitor requires >30% commit, highlight Redwood reliability and fallback policies in rebuttal doc.

Recent artifacts: Fireflies call IDs above, Drive: pricing_playbook_v2.pdf, security FAQ link. Jira RED-3421 covers security evidence request.

Likelihood: low-to-medium without price flexibility or smaller micro-commit. CFO appears to prefer competitor price or pause spend.
